title: 2020 AMC 10A Problem 11
statement: What is the median of the following list of \(4040\) numbers? \[ \begin{aligned} &1,2,3,\ldots,2020,\\ &1^2,2^2,3^2,\ldots,2020^2 \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
For a number near the median, the sorted list includes all ordinary integers up to that number and all squares up to that number. Since \(44^2=1936\) and \(45^2=2025\), there are \(44\) squares not exceeding any number from \(1936\) through \(2020\).

At \(1975\), there are \(1975+44=2019\) list entries at most \(1975\). At \(1976\), there are \(2020\) entries at most \(1976\), so the \(2020\)th entry is \(1976\), and the next is \(1977\). The median is \(1976.5\). Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Near the median, count ordinary integers and square numbers separately
